subject.title: Feature: Support custom anthropic_beta flags in Bedrock model config

question: Should the Amazon Bedrock plugin expose a broad `additionalModelRequestFields`/`providerFields` merge contract, a narrower `anthropicBeta` or long-context option, or keep Anthropic beta flags internal?
rationale: The missing source path is clear, but adding request-body config becomes a public provider contract and the repository config-surface bar requires maintainer intent before choosing the shape.

options.title: Expose a Bedrock-owned merge contract
options.body: Add a schema-validated merge point for Bedrock vendor request fields, define `anthropic_beta` dedup/precedence behavior, and document the supported surface.

options.title: Expose only a narrow beta option
options.body: Support a typed Bedrock `anthropicBeta` or long-context option while avoiding arbitrary request-field passthrough.

options.title: Decline custom beta config
options.body: Keep beta flags as provider-owned internal behavior and require first-class OpenClaw support for each Bedrock feature instead of user-supplied request fields.

recommendation.title: Expose a Bedrock-owned merge contract
recommendation.body: Add a schema-validated merge point for Bedrock vendor request fields, define `anthropic_beta` dedup/precedence behavior, and document the supported surface.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent Bedrock provider runtime/options work makes this the closest observed owner for the request-shaping and schema decision.
